# FIXTURE — exercises: aeo-bot-access-audit, Steps 2/3/5. Expected verdict: OPEN.
# The posture the skill recommends as the more defensible default: block training
# crawlers, allow retrieval/citation crawlers, announce the sitemap.
# The trap to notice: a site that blocks `GPTBot` believing it blocks ChatGPT Search
# is still fully cited by it, because ChatGPT Search fetches as `OAI-SearchBot`.
# `Google-Extended` is allowed here because it governs Gemini training and Vertex AI
# grounding, not Googlebot ranking or Google AI Overviews.

# --- retrieval and citation bots: allow -------------------------------------------
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# --- training crawlers: block ------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

# --- admin paths stay closed, assets stay open ------------------------------------
User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /cart/
Allow: /wp-content/uploads/

Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml
